name: cancel_workstream
description: Cancel in-flight generation on a child and unblock any pending approval / plan review. Does not close or delete - state moves to `idle` (tokens spent on the in-flight call are dropped); pair with send_to_workstream for a fresh prompt or close_workstream to retire. Use when a child is stuck on an approval you no longer want to grant or off the rails on a long thinking turn. Returns `{ws_id, cancelled, status}` plus `dropped` when the node captured forensics: always `was_running` (true = mid-generation), plus `pending_approval` {tool_names, call_id} and/or `queued_messages` {count, first_preview} when present. Read `was_running` first to judge whether the cancel actually interrupted work.

ws_id.description: Workstream id to cancel - exactly 32 hex chars, copied verbatim. Unknown or malformed ids error with did-you-mean suggestions; nothing is ever guessed.
